digest.component_or_area: code-review impact model and tests criterion
propositions: code-review gate cannot block consequential test-sufficiency findings because code-v3 impact model discards verifier user-reach judgments via churn-based dampening

contract-contradicting assertions (state forbade by test, allowed by contract) ship undetected because pass-1 litmus matches no antipattern and pass-3 maintainability scores land at 0.30 vs advisory threshold 0.95

prod_impact and trigger_likelihood fields are answered by verifiers for maintainability findings but discarded by v3 lane scorer, leaving 70 load-bearing prod=medium/high test findings incorrectly advisory

v4 impact model must split maintainability lane by consequence class, restore prod_impact user-reach keying for moderate consequences, restrict reversibility floor to consequence lanes only, and promote tests to blocking@0.54
new forbids_contract_allowed_state binary with both-halves-verbatim evidence and deliberate-tightening guard must be added to CodeSeverityAttrs and verify prompt
stored code-v3 sidecars must not be rewritten or re-scored in place; version gating ensures new reviews emit code-v4 while existing sidecars remain immutable
